items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Miss Neal would tell me get letters, they come in. Boom, boom, boom, boom. Miss Bella read my letter.

ctx.x: And he just looked at me. He said, where you come from? I said, Bluxy. He said, you went to school? I said, I went to ninth grade and I walked a whole mile with Brogan shoes on, bravest tips. And he just looked at me. He said, well, you... He said, your education is pretty good. I went to ninth grade and I wanted to go to college. When my mother died and left my dad was 16th year old, that made me and my biggest sister had to work. But don't you think we don't know how to read and write and figure? I know if I...…
Well, some people didn't get the chance though. Some people didn't have the chance to go to school.
